lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid of high-luminance circular clusters organized in five distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, displaying a roughly equidistant spatial arrangement in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Lighter vertical bands are visible between the columns of spots, creating a lattice where spots are positioned at the nodes of horizontal and vertical intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is located on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance above to low luminance shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) swimming closely beneath the ventral region, posterior to the pectoral fin.
